en.text:
Kills create a Remnant which tracks towards you when within a 15 meter radius. Remnants last for 8 seconds in the world before despawning.

Remnants <title refill [G_refill] /> 4 rounds into the magazine and grant one stack of 'Noble Rounds'. Maximum of 6 stacks.

Receiving a 'Noble Seeker' from a rift empowered by <yellow Boots Of The Assembler /> also grants one Noble Round.
